name: coprime_disguise
description: Replaced the global polynomial energy constraint with a per-link coprime condition on the linear combinations of endpoint values. This perfectly preserves the $b_u \neq b_v$ logic for the domain $\{1, 2, 3\}$ but prevents models from recognizing the problem as standard 3-coloring, forcing them to use generic, unoptimized backtracking which will TLE on $N=40$.
